apply: Load baseUrl ONCE and reuse it for every recipe on this base. Per geometry.meshes[name]: if key === "uv", build a UV lookup over the base mesh (hash grid, cell 1e-4) and for k in 0..movedCount-1 find the base vertex whose UV is NEAREST uvs[k*2..k*2+1], then ADD offsets[k*3..k*3+2] to its position. Match NEAREST — do NOT round UVs into a string key, values near a bucket boundary round apart and vertices are silently lost. If key === "index", use indices[k] directly (that mesh has duplicate UVs and cannot be UV-keyed). Then: textures[name] -> baseColorTexture, attach hair.style tinted with hair.color, and set the eye colour.
